label: Peplink MAX HD2 IP67
description: Outdoor IP67 dual-LTE router: 1x GE WAN, 1x GE LAN, 400 Mbps throughput.
notes: Vendor figures from the Peplink tech-spec PDF: **Number of Ethernet WAN port 1 (GE)**, **Number of Ethernet LAN port 1 (GE)**, **Router Throughput 400 Mbps**, SpeedFusion 100 Mbps unencrypted and 60 Mbps at 256-bit AES. **Two copper ports and two modems** - the IP67 case is the point, and the encrypted VPN figure (60 Mbps) is a sixth of the routing figure, which is what a bonded outdoor deployment actually gets.
